description: An attachments group (-C) whose first element is the genus/version code -_AAACAA, then a -K of one signature. -C is one of the universal codes that allow a genus/version override, so the parser must take the code as switching tables for the group (here to the table already in force) and must not read it as a group member or a count.
title: A genus/version code may open an attachments group
